# Forward FFT sharing

The seven active Harmonic bands previously performed the same 65,536-point forward FFT independently for each channel and block. This revision computes one source forward FFT per channel/block, copies the deterministic complex spectrum for each band, then applies the original band-specific mask, inverse FFT, harmonic synthesis, gain, and final blend unchanged. Inverse FFT count intentionally remains one per band. The existing diagnostics remain enabled, so a typical stereo Harmonic call with seven bands should report two forward FFT calls instead of fourteen, while band operations and inverse FFT calls remain fourteen. The implementation does not change FFT length, band definitions, mask equations, harmonic equations, L/R parallelism, Dynamic, Stereo Width, encoding, metadata, or two-stage cover finalization.
